reviews.text: Yesterday I encountered a dog walker from that company with almost 10 dogs on Arthur Azevedo street, which I already find absurdly large. One of the dogs simply looked to the side and the guy slapped the animal hard in the face. I complained on Instagram and they blocked or deleted my account. If you're going to mistreat animals, go get a job somewhere else. If I see it again, I'll call the police.

Dog Blitz transformed my routine with my dog! In just one month of service, the stress decreased significantly, and she became much calmer and more obedient. Pedro provided super personalized service, understanding our needs and closely monitoring our progress. Their app is also excellent and shows all the details of the walk. Impeccable service and continuous support. I highly recommend them!

I want to give a special compliment to Dani, my dog ​​Nala's walker. They got along super well from the first moment! Dani is excellent, extremely attentive, and after each walk, she sends me a complete report detailing how Nala behaved and pointing out any details I should pay attention to at home. I trust her completely!
I loved the experience! Zeus is loving it and already knows the time of the outings. He eagerly awaits Uncle Pedro's arrival!

We hired the dog walking service to help with the dogs' routine and anxiety. From the beginning, the team was super attentive and answered all my questions! Our experience with the walks was very good, the dogs really enjoyed it, and everything was done with great care and kindness. We are very happy with the results and highly recommend this service to anyone who needs it!
Pedro is very attentive, and so is Igor, who walks my dogs. One of them, who usually doesn't go out without me, runs to the door when she sees him arriving.
Pedro and Daniela are very patient and attentive; I will definitely call them again if needed! After every tour, they provide a report, which is great.
Excellent service, the app allows you to track the tour information, and Samba loved the walker and his walking friends. I highly recommend it.

We are super happy with our partnership with Dog Blitz. The walks have taught our dog Lucky discipline while also helping him expend energy in the best way. Pedro is a very professional person who has helped us a lot with our Lucky, as he was always anxious, barking a lot at everyone and everything, and today we already see the difference; Lucky is much gentler and calmer. Pedro always picks up Lucky with enthusiasm, always with a lot of attention and affection. I highly recommend him.
Our dog loved his walks with Dog Blitz and adored his walker, Daniela. She was caring, reliable, and clearly great with dogs. We couldn’t be happier!

I am extremely satisfied with the results of Dog Blitz's work! From the beginning, Pedro demonstrated great dedication, patience, and professionalism.
My two pets, who previously had a lot of anxiety and difficulties with commands, have already undergone a radical change in a short time, which indicates that the methodology was effective.
I highly recommend the work of Pedro and his team to anyone looking to improve their dog's behavior in a safe and humane way.
Loving the service! Now we go to work much more relaxed knowing our pet will get a nice walk in the middle of the afternoon.
Very responsible and careful, my dogs have been going for walks for months and they love it! Reliable service, 10 out of 10!

A very serious and professional company. Our dogs eagerly and happily await their walk every day – they love Dani, the dog walker. Excellent, attentive, and punctual service. 10 out of 10! Highly recommend!
My dogs loved the walks with Dog Blitz!
They are super attentive and caring with my little one! Donatella loves them!

The whole experience was great.
My dog ​​got to burn off the necessary energy and got along really well with both Igor and his walking companion.

In my case, it was an excellent trade-off between regular walks and daycare (where I felt I was stressed).

The best dog walking company in Pinheiros. Pedro and Igor are attentive and punctual and helped my baby Myla gain confidence. The walks are varied and Igor is very reliable, and I receive daily updates and photos from Pedro. I can't recommend Dog Blintz enough!
I love them so much! They are incredibly attentive to my dog, who is super shy and fearful. He's getting better and better and loves Dani (the dog walker) so much.

I am very satisfied with the dog walking service! My dog ​​loves her walker, Igor, and gets super excited every time he arrives. The service is extremely professional, always punctual and attentive. It's very reassuring to know that she is in good hands and receiving the love and care she deserves. I recommend them without hesitation!
